services.name: Revolutionary Settlers Exhibit
services.desc: Livermore was first settled in the late 1780s-right after the Revolutionary War, which ended with the Treaty of Paris on September 3, 1783. As a result, many of Livermore’s earliest settlers were involved in the war, either by directly fighting against the British themselves or supporting family members who did. Click on the map to learn about Livermore’s role in several major Revolutionary War battles. Years of tension between the American colonists and British monarchy came to a head in the first battles of the Revolutionary War.
